006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.IErrorCode;
009
010import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
011
012/**
013 * FODT: Exceptions related to Date/Time/Duration errors.
014 */
015public class DateTimeFunctionException
016    extends FunctionMetapathError {
017  @NonNull
018  private static final String PREFIX = "FODT";
019  /**
020   * <a href=
021   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#ERRFODT0001">err:FODT0001</a>:
022   * Raised when casting to date/time datatypes, or performing arithmetic with
023   * date/time values, if arithmetic overflow or underflow occurs.
024   */
025  public static final int DATE_TIME_OVERFLOW_UNDERFLOW_ERROR = 1;
026  /**
027   * <a href=
028   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#ERRFODT0002">err:FODT0002</a>:
029   * Raised when casting to duration datatypes, or performing arithmetic with
030   * duration values, if arithmetic overflow or underflow occurs.
031   */
032  public static final int DURATION_OVERFLOW_UNDERFLOW_ERROR = 2;
033  /**
034   * <a href=
035   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#ERRFODT0003">err:FODT0003</a>:
036   * Raised by adjust-date-to-timezone and related functions if the supplied
037   * timezone is invalid.
038   */
039  public static final int INVALID_TIME_ZONE_VALUE_ERROR = 3;
040
041  /**
042   * the serial version UID.
043   */
044  private static final long serialVersionUID = 2L;
045
046  /**
047   * Constructs a new exception with the provided {@code code}, {@code message},
048   * and no cause.
049   *
050   * @param code
051   *          the error code value
052   * @param message
053   *          the exception message
054   */
055  public DateTimeFunctionException(int code, String message) {
056    super(IErrorCode.of(PREFIX, code), message);
057  }
058
059  /**
060   * Constructs a new exception with the provided {@code code}, {@code message},
061   * and {@code cause}.
062   *
063   * @param code
064   *          the error code value
065   * @param message
066   *          the exception message
067   * @param cause
068   *          the original exception cause
069   */
070  public DateTimeFunctionException(int code, String message, Throwable cause) {
071    super(IErrorCode.of(PREFIX, code), message, cause);
072  }
073
074  /**
075   * Constructs a new exception with the provided {@code code}, no message, and
076   * the {@code cause}.
077   *
078   * @param code
079   *          the error code value
080   * @param cause
081   *          the original exception cause
082   */
083  public DateTimeFunctionException(int code, Throwable cause) {
084    super(IErrorCode.of(PREFIX, code), cause);
085  }
086}
